responsibility_name: keep needed fridge items stocked

evidence.evidence_text: When a certain food is missing in the fridge, send a notification and add the product to the shopping list on the fridge LED.

coding.rationale: Missing fridge food triggers replenishment, directly supporting continued household food stock.

responsibility_name: Keep the beer dispenser stocked

evidence.evidence_text: If the smart beer dispenser detects that the content of the current boiler is less than 50% and the reserve stock is less than 2 boilers then it will be automatically added to the Google Home shopping list Refill Beer ” also sending a notification to the stored phone ""Added 'Recharge Beer' to Google shopping list"

coding.rationale: Low current and reserve beer stock triggers replenishment, maintaining the household supply.

responsibility_name: keep the household stocked with usual foods

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN user NOT at home IF the fridge is empty SEND the user an SMS reminding him to go shopping with the list of foods he usually eats

coding.rationale: An empty home prompts shopping for usual foods, addressing a household food shortage while unoccupied.

coding.rationale: Heating before the alarm is intended to make the room comfortable when the resident wakes.

responsibility_name: Ensure the room is warm after showering

responsibility_name: Ensure ventilation while cooking

responsibility_name: keep evening rooms lit

responsibility_name: keep the evening kitchen warm

responsibility_name: Maintain bedroom warmth in the evening

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature

evidence.evidence_text: Very strange. Today at 11 o’clock, I started to think that it was a bit cold… it was set to ‘not at home’… programmed to ‘not-home’ during daytime on Thursdays and Fridays.
When the user is at home and the temperature is below 14°, activate the heating.

coding.rationale: The evidence links heating to being at home and to a cold indoor temperature, supporting occupant comfort.

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature and humidity

evidence.evidence_text: If the house temperature is not higher than 17°, TURN UP the heating and CHECK the air humidity level, if humidity <35% ACTIVATE the humidifier

coding.rationale: Low temperature and low humidity trigger heating and humidification to maintain indoor comfort.

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature when occupied

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is detected in a room, if the temperature is below 18 degrees, turn on the heating, the electric blanket and the dehumidifier

coding.rationale: Detecting the user in a cold room triggers heating and related comfort measures.

responsibility_name: maintain indoor air quality

evidence.evidence_text: When the smoke detector detects cigarette smoke in the house and if the windows are closed, the windows open or the air purification system is switched on.
If the windows in the house are closed for more than 24h and the air purifier detects high levels of CO2, the windows open and the purifier starts working sanitizing the air

coding.rationale: Smoke or high CO2 with closed windows triggers ventilation or purification to maintain air quality.

responsibility_name: maintain morning shower comfort with heating

responsibility_name: send the news of the day during the shower

coding.rationale: High kitchen humidity with a closed window triggers ventilation to maintain a safe humidity level.

responsibility_name: maintain warm bed before nighttime use

coding.rationale: At 21:00, low room temperature triggers bed warming before nighttime use.

responsibility_name: maintain warm indoor temperature when home

evidence.evidence_text: IF the temperature is below 18°C WHILE the user is at home, CLOSE all windows and TURN ON the radiators.

coding.rationale: When home and indoor temperature is low, closing windows and heating maintain warmth.

responsibility_name: restore radiator heating automatically

evidence.evidence_text: If a radiator does not work, the boiler is reset and the water pressure is increased.

coding.rationale: A failed radiator triggers boiler reset and pressure adjustment to restore heating.

responsibility_name: Support midday cooking by preheating the oven

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the kitchen and the time is between 12:00 - 14:00, the oven turns on.

coding.rationale: Midday kitchen entry triggers oven activation to prepare for cooking.

responsibility_name: use efficient heating energy source

evidence.evidence_text: When the user turns on the heating, if the temperature detected in the solar panels is above 40 degrees, deactivate the boiler and activate the heating with the solar panels

coding.rationale: When solar heat is sufficient, heating switches energy source to avoid inefficient boiler use.

responsibility_name: Ensure occupants are alerted when mail arrives

evidence.evidence_text: When the mailbox sensor detects content, a notification light will turn on inside the house.

coding.rationale: Mailbox content triggers an indoor notification so occupants know mail has arrived.

responsibility_name: Ensure visitors are acknowledged when nobody is home

evidence.evidence_text: When someone rings the doorbell but no one is at home, a notification arrives on the phone that warns of the presence of the guest and the bell speaker signals that no one can open.

coding.rationale: When nobody is home, a visitor is acknowledged through a remote alert and doorbell response.

responsibility_name: monitor door visitors when family away

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN someone rings the intercom IF family NOT at home AND IF devices in «do not disturb» mode SHOW surveillance camera video and VIEW message on doorbell display

coding.rationale: Intercom ringing while family is away provides surveillance and a message about the visitor.

responsibility_name: monitor doorbell visitors remotely when away

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN someone rings the bell WHILE user is not home, SEND security camera frame to user's phone.

coding.rationale: A remote camera frame on doorbell ringing keeps the absent user informed of visitors.

responsibility_name: Stay informed of intercom visitors when away

evidence.evidence_text: If the intercom rings and no one is at home, SEND a message to the user's cell phone

coding.rationale: A message on intercom ringing while away informs the user that someone is visiting.
